description: Duplicate a checklist into one or more new checklists on the same trip. Each copy keeps item text and sections; every item starts unchecked. Provide source_note_id (a checklist segment ID from trip_details) and one title per copy (max 10).

source_note_id.description: ID of the checklist to copy (from trip_details).

titles.description: One title per copy (1 to 10, each up to 200 characters).
